properties.name: Yarok14 Technologies
properties.description:
Yarok14 Technologies is a semiconductor and AI hardware engineering company delivering advanced ASIC design, FPGA prototyping, RTL verification, physical design, DFT, embedded systems, and AI/ML solutions for global engineering teams. We specialize in secure, NDA-driven semiconductor development workflows — from architecture definition and RTL implementation to tape-out support and silicon validation.

Our core engineering capabilities include ASIC & FPGA design, RTL-to-GDSII physical design, UVM/formal verification, Design for Test (DFT), AI hardware acceleration, embedded & IoT systems, and cloud-native DevOps infrastructure. We support complex silicon programs with services spanning synthesis, floorplanning, CTS, routing, STA, IR/EM analysis, scan insertion, MBIST, ATPG, regression automation, and secure deployment pipelines.

Yarok14 Technologies also develops specialized products such as an Automated Front-End VLSI Design AI Tool, an IoT-Based Biomethane Optimization System, the Yarok-14 Microprocessor Unit (MuP), an AI Edge Acceleration Platform, and a portfolio of secure soft and hard IP solutions for industrial and mission-critical applications. These solutions are built for sectors including robotics, industrial automation, agriculture, automotive, drones, and other high-reliability domains.

We collaborate with semiconductor startups, fabless design houses, AI hardware innovators, and industrial automation teams worldwide, with experience supporting advanced low-power and sub-16nm FinFET technologies. Our mission is to help customers accelerate tape-outs, improve verification quality, optimize AI performance, and scale innovation from FPGA to production silicon.
